description: Glob patterns for modules intentionally not imported via standard import statements. Each pattern documents the discovery/registration mechanism that makes the module reachable at runtime. See docs/standards/static-analysis.md.

patterns.syntara/*/__main__.py: CLI entrypoint invoked via python -m (e.g., python -m syntara.seed)
patterns.syntara/*/cli/__main__.py: CLI entrypoint invoked via python -m (e.g., python -m syntara.credentials.cli)
patterns.syntara/*/migrations/env.py: Alembic migration environment — invoked by Alembic CLI, not imported
patterns.syntara/*/migrations/versions/*.py: Alembic migration scripts — invoked by Alembic CLI, not imported
patterns.syntara/*/error_handlers.py: Resolved at runtime via string-based handler refs in @fastapi_exception decorators
patterns.syntara/core/storage_error_handlers.py: Resolved at runtime via string-based handler refs in @fastapi_exception decorators
patterns.syntara/*/audit/*.py: Audit event handlers — discovered by audit.discovery.discover_handlers() at startup
patterns.syntara/telemetry/handlers/*.py: Telemetry event handlers — discovered by handler scanning at startup
patterns.syntara/telemetry/middleware.py: Registered as middleware during app startup in main.py
patterns.syntara/*/ws/*.py: WebSocket handlers — discovered via AsyncAPI spec + convention-based importlib loading
patterns.syntara/example/*.py: Reference implementations for developers, not production code
patterns.syntara/example/*/*.py: Reference implementations for developers, not production code
patterns.syntara/api/main.py: Application entrypoint — invoked via uvicorn/python -m, not imported
patterns.syntara/*/worker.py: Background worker entrypoints — invoked via python -m in podman-compose
patterns.syntara/*/background_worker.py: Background queue worker entrypoint — invoked via python -m in podman-compose
patterns.syntara/*/worker_lifecycle.py: Shared worker lifecycle utilities — imported by worker entrypoints but not by the main application graph
patterns.syntara/*/utils.py: Intra-package utilities — imported via package (from syntara.X import utils), not direct module import
patterns.syntara/workflows/utils/template_resolut: Functions imported directly by name (resolve_value) from consuming modules, not via module path
patterns.syntara/files/validators.py: Imported via package (from syntara.files import validators) in file_manager.py
Postgres audit event DB model — orphaned by AAP-78344 (export module removed); will be deleted with audit DB retirement in sibling tasks
patterns.syntara/workflows/workflow_engine/activi: Temporal activities — discovered and registered at runtime by Temporal worker, not via direct imports
Stub implementation awaiting Phase 3 database integration — not yet wired into the workflow engine
patterns.syntara/integrations/lib/credential_reso: Statically imported by integration_service.py and invocation_executor.py; pyan3 does not trace through session-factory closures into background tasks
patterns.syntara/core/tls/protocol.py: Loaded by uvicorn via --http string import at runtime, not via Python import
patterns.syntara/core/tls/certs.py: Imported by scripts/generate_local_certs.py and tests/helpers/tls.py — both outside src/
patterns.syntara/files/health.py: File storage health check — imported by files/router.py for GET /files/storage_status and by api/main.py for startup validation; pyan3 does not trace either edge
patterns.syntara/files/workers/file_cleanup.py: Background worker — invoked via scheduled task, not direct import
patterns.syntara/authz/_rego_runtime.py: Isolated regopy runtime — imported by evaluator.py; kept separate to avoid C extension memory leak
